name: tibo-hook
description: Drafts or sends a privacy-minimized Codex capacity review request after a verified usage-limit event.

interface.shortDescription: Prepare a capacity review request after a verified limit.
interface.longDescription: Experimental local Codex hook that detects a structured usage-limit event, applies strict deduplication and privacy rules, then creates an .eml draft by default or sends it through user-configured SMTP.
defaultPrompt: Configure tibo-hook and preview the request email.
